ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food web, with the bottom labeled “Cladophora, epiphytic diatoms, Nostoc”. From this bottom label, arrows point upward to “Tuft-weaving chironomids”, and then further connect to consumers such as fish and insects. Reasoning: In a food web, producers are usually located at the bottom, can make their own food, and provide energy for consumers. Among the organisms listed at the bottom, the producer that meets the question requirement is epiphytic diatoms.
